caption: The drawing depicts a full-length figure of a man standing on a rectangular base. He is dressed in a dark navy blue robe with light blue highlights, which reaches down to his feet. The robe is belted at the waist and features a decorative element near the bottom consisting of red and yellow tassels. He has a neatly trimmed black beard and mustache and short dark hair with a distinct hairline. His left hand holds a tan-colored skull, while his right hand extends outward holding a red cross. The robe has long sleeves with a hint of a brownish cuff exposed on the right sleeve. The background is a plain, off-white color, and there are no other objects or scenery present in the drawing. The artist’s signature, “Polly Duncan ‘38,” is located near the bottom left corner of the artwork.
title: Santo (Bulto)
